evidence: Carries the P2P label, modifies peer socket polling logic in src/net.cpp, and adds functional tests for peer socket error conditions.
rationale: Prevents network event loops from entering a busy loop when receiving TCP urgent data and avoids bypassing receive backpressure under poll errors. As noted in the commit message, 'select() can keep reporting a TCP urgent indication even when recv() has no data to read... disconnect to avoid a busy loop.'
